analysis.overall: You spent a solid 83% of the day in range with an average of 117 mg/dL, though meal doses repeatedly triggered sharp dips into low territory followed by brief rebound peaks.

events.title: Post-lunch peak
events.description: A 60g carb lunch at 1:50 PM led to a gradual rise peaking at 190 mg/dL before small correction boluses brought you back down.

events.title: Pre-dinner mild low
events.description: Correction insulin from the afternoon slowly drifted your glucose down to a low of 62 mg/dL before dinner.

events.title: Post-dinner drop
events.description: After dinner, your 3.8u bolus acted quickly, dropping glucose from 142 mg/dL down to 68 mg/dL before stabilizing overnight.

events.title: Early morning dip
events.description: Glucose drifted down early in the morning to 60 mg/dL before naturally rising as you woke up.

events.title: Breakfast drop and rebound
events.description: A heavy breakfast dose caused a quick drop to 60 mg/dL, which triggered a swift rebound up to 190 mg/dL before leveling off smoothly around 90 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Pay attention to mealtime timing and corrections, as full boluses tended to cause rapid drops about an hour after eating.
